title: Apply for the NSW Gas Rebate (on-supply and bottled gas customers)
summary: Find out if you are eligible for and how to apply for the NSW Gas Rebate for natural gas or bottled LPG customers.
intro:
The NSW Gas Rebate helps eligible concession cardholders pay their natural gas or bottled Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) bills.

If you live in an embedded network (on-supply) or if you buy or refill bottled LPG, you can apply for the rebate.

If you are a retail (on-market) customer, you can apply for the NSW Gas Rebate (retail customers).

Note: Embedded network (on-supply) means your natural gas is supplied by an embedded network – such as in a residential community, retirement village or strata scheme – and you receive your gas bill or invoice from the strata manager or community/village operator. If you’re not sure whether you're an on-supply customer, contact the gas provider named on your gas bill.
who_can_apply: You live in NSW and have a natural gas account for your home or use LPG bottles of more than 45 kg/88 litres for basic household needs.
You are the account holder (the account and bill must be in your name).
You hold one of the following energy providers: ARC Energy Group, Energy Locals, Origin Energy (including most of their WINConnect sites), or Locality Planning Energy (LPE) at specific sites.
You are a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card holder.
You are an LPG customer who uses 'SWAP&GO' BBQ bottles, or bottled gas less than 45 kg/88 litres in mass.
You are a gas hot water customer with usage measured in litres.
You are a customer billed for an unmetered gas service.
If you receive your natural gas bill from certain energy providers (from 1 July 2025), you must contact your retailer to apply for the NSW Gas Rebate.
what_you_need: Your bank account details (to receive your rebate).
A printed (not hand-written) copy of your latest gas bill (JPG or PDF file) that does not include bills for additional services like service charge or equipment fee.

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Follow the steps to apply for the rebate.
Download and complete the application form – NSW Gas Rebate Application Form On-Supply – PDF.
Attach a copy of your most recent gas bill/invoice.
Post your application to NSW Energy Rebates, PO Box 435, Parramatta NSW 2124.

more_info.text: Embedded network (on supply) customers receive the rebate as a lump sum payment of $121 deposited into your bank account.
For assistance in understanding your bill or invoice, please contact your energy provider.
A household can only receive one NSW Gas Rebate each financial year.
You can only receive the rebate for your principal place of residence.
If you receive the NSW Gas Rebate, you may be eligible for the NSW Low Income Household Rebate for your electricity account.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the NSW Gas Rebate?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you live in NSW and meet specific criteria, such as having a natural gas account or using LPG bottles of more than 45 kg/88 litres for basic household needs, and being the account holder.

An on-supply customer means your natural gas is supplied by an embedded network, such as in a residential community, retirement village, or strata scheme, and you receive your bill from the strata manager or community/village operator.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the NSW Gas Rebate?
faqs.a: You can check your eligibility, select 'Apply online,' follow the steps, and then download and complete the application form, before posting your application to NSW Energy Rebates, PO Box 435, Parramatta NSW 2124.
